question: What was the most expensive incoming transfer to a Premier League club in the 2023-2024 season window?
answer: The most expensive incoming transfer to a Premier League club in the 2023-2024 season window was **Declan Rice**, who moved from West Ham United to Arsenal for a fee of **£116,600,000**.
sql:
SELECT pt.player_id, p.player_name, pt.from_team, pt.to_team, pt.transfer_fee
FROM player_transfers pt
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
WHERE pt.season = '2023-2024'
  AND pt.to_team IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.team_name
    FROM team_season_standings tss
    JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tss.team_id
    JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = tss.season_id
    WHERE s.competition_id = 1
  )
  AND pt.transfer_fee IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pt.transfer_fee DESC
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: player_transfers has season, transfer_fee, to_team (TEXT club name), from_team, transfer_type. Filter season='2023-2024' and transfer_type indicating incoming/permanent; identify PL clubs by matching to_team against canonical PL team_names (teams table, but note this table spans 5 leagues so restrict to_team to the ~20 PL clubs). Order by transfer_fee DESC LIMIT 1. transfer_fee is text/numeric—cast carefully and exclude NULL/loan/free. No season_id join available here since player_transfers keys on season text only; PL scoping must be done via the to_team club name since transfers lack a league_code.
